description: This PHP source file defines the AuthController class responsible for handling user authentication related actions such as login, logout, signup, password recovery, password reset, and OAuth integrations within the Goteo project. It manages user sessions, redirects, and interactions with user models and external OAuth providers.

classes.name: AuthController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for user authentication processes including login, signup, logout, password recovery and reset, and OAuth integrations within the Goteo system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the AuthController and sets the theme for views.

methods.name: redirectLoginAction
methods.description: Redirects the user to the login page with current query parameters.

methods.name: checkSession
methods.description: Checks if the user session is active; if logged in, dispatches an event; if SSL is required, redirects to HTTPS.

methods.name: checkLogin
methods.description: Checks if the user is logged in or attempts to authenticate via username and password. Handles session setting and redirects on success.

methods.name: loginAction
methods.description: Handles login page rendering or redirects based on login status.

methods.name: logoutAction
methods.description: Logs out the user, manages session destruction, and redirect to previous URL or default.

methods.name: checkSignup
methods.description: Validates and processes user signup data, performs validation, creates user, and logs in if successful.

methods.name: signupAction
methods.description: Displays the signup form or processes signup based on validation.

methods.name: passwordRecoveryAction
methods.description: Handles password recovery requests, token decoding, and password reset initiation.

methods.name: passwordResetAction
methods.description: Handles password reset submissions, updates user password, and manages redirection.

methods.name: oauthAction
methods.description: Manages OAuth login flows with external providers, including authentication, linking, and user creation.

methods.name: oauthSignupAction
methods.description: Handles user registration via OAuth providers, account linking, and user data import.
